note: Documents named during the two reviews, each because it exercises a mechanism the schema handles badly or not at all. Every one of these must be in the extraction set and, eventually, in the fixture. 'source' says who found it.

cases.why: An arriving substitute (Ευθυμίου for Λυμπεράτος) is absent from ΣΥΜΜΕΤΕΧΟΝΤΕΣ while a different substitute with the same annotation is present. This is the document that proved the roll call is opening-only and that a merged present/roster flag reads it backwards.
A third roll-call column, ΑΠΟΧΩΡΗΣΑΝΤΕΣ, scoping a departure to the decision this document records. Per-decision attendance stated directly.
The contrast case for the above: same body, same meeting shape, no ΑΠΟΧΩΡΗΣΑΝΤΕΣ column. Together they prove the column is per-decision rather than per-session.
«Εκτός αιθούσης στις με αρ. 31 – 40 ΑΔΣ ο κ. Εμμ. Βελεγράκης» — temporarily out of the room across a RANGE of decisions, which is not a departure.
The mayor is absent and RETURNS during item 3, and the same document records a change in discussion order. Two hard mechanisms in one page.
The decision body embeds transcript excerpts of the voting itself, so the excerpt boundary is ambiguous.
The only Argithea committee document recording any attendance change: two members withdraw after the urgency vote, pinned to a decision number.
Two minority members walk out after the 8th item with a recorded statement of reasons.
51 pages. A departure after the 8th item, and the document where extraction emitted a bracketed placeholder instead of the decision content.
Absent members with no substitute named — the shape that shows Argithea's substitution case is missing from our corpus entirely.
ΠΑΡΟΝΤΕΣ silently contains substitutes, ΑΠΟΝΤΕΣ is incomplete (Βαρδάκης appears in neither), and two arrivals are pinned to decision numbers. The open question for the municipality.

Embeds a committee decision, a traffic-committee decision and a community-council decision, with four attendance lists and three ΑΠΟΦΑΣΙΖΕΙ blocks. Extraction correctly took only the council's own data — keep as a regression case.
The σύνθεση is an invitation roster, not an attendance list, and two members arrive during item 1 while appearing in it. This is why composition-minus-absent reads cumulative.
An arrival in a body whose roll call is otherwise cumulative.
139 pages, with the decision on the LAST page behind a bound-in study. Breaks any read-the-first-N-pages strategy.
19 pages; extraction truncated after item 1 and lost the decision's own items 2 and 3 sitting after an embedded contract.
A straight double quote in the source truncated the excerpt and spilled decision text into decisionNumber and references.
Twelve attendance changes, every one pinned to a decision number, all of which reach the schema with a null agenda item.
Composition plus an absent sentence, arrivals and departures pinned to agenda items, and named ΚΑΤΑ and ΛΕΥΚΟ voters.
States that items 21 to 23 were moved after item 7, and that a member left during item 11. Reordering plus a pinned departure.
A late arrival annotated inside the absent list, «(ΠΡΟΣΗΛΘΕ ΣΤΟ 1ο ΘΕΜΑ)», plus a named per-vote absence from the room.
Three arrivals during item 1 who are named in the absent sentence and in the roster. The composition-layout case that settles what its present set means.
